# Career Unified

> Career Unified is a South African careers platform for jobs, bursaries, CV tools, Direct Apply recruitment, and approved partner integrations.

Website: https://careerunified.com/
Jobs: https://careerunified.com/jobs
Bursaries: https://careerunified.com/bursaries
CV tools: https://careerunified.com/cv-generator/
Recruiter platform: https://careerunified.com/for-recruiters
Partner API documentation: https://careerunified.com/api/
Partner API machine-readable guide: https://careerunified.com/api/llms.txt
OpenAPI contract: https://careerunified.com/api/openapi.yaml
